summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing poll results of its October 8, 2026 extraordinary general meeting held in Shanghai, where shareholders approved by ordinary resolution an amendment and supplemental agreement extending the maturity of outstanding Ping An Overseas Holdings Convertible Promissory Notes by one year, from October 8, 2026 to October 8, 2027. The board also received a specific mandate to allot new shares of US$2.32 par value upon conversion, subject to HKEX approval. This is a routine EGM results notice concerning an affiliate note extension, not a special situation; watch conversion-driven share issuance and any HKEX mandate approval overhang.
